    model = SmallCNN().to(dev)
    model.load_state_dict(torch.load(CNN_DIR / final["run"] / "model.pt", map_location=dev))
    model.eval()
    x = torch.from_numpy(np.stack([resize(m) for m in maps])).to(dev)
